body.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM otel_logs;
SELECT severity_text, COUNT(*) AS c FROM otel_logs GROUP BY severity_text ORDER BY c DESC;
SELECT service_name, COUNT(*) AS c FROM otel_logs GROUP BY service_name ORDER BY c DESC;
SELECT resource_cloud_region, COUNT(*) AS c FROM otel_logs GROUP BY resource_cloud_region ORDER BY c DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM otel_logs WHERE severity_text LIKE 'ERROR';
SELECT log_http_method, log_http_status_code, COUNT(*) AS c FROM otel_logs GROUP BY log_http_method, log_http_status_code ORDER BY c DESC;
SELECT log_http_status_code, COUNT(*) AS c FROM otel_logs WHERE log_http_status_code >= 500 GROUP BY log_http_status_code ORDER BY c DESC;
SELECT resource_k8s_namespace_name, COUNT(*) AS c FROM otel_logs GROUP BY resource_k8s_namespace_name ORDER BY c DESC;
SELECT resource_telemetry_sdk_language, COUNT(*) AS c FROM otel_logs GROUP BY resource_telemetry_sdk_language ORDER BY c DESC;
SELECT severity_text, service_name, COUNT(*) AS c FROM otel_logs GROUP BY severity_text, service_name ORDER BY c DESC;
SELECT AVG(severity_number) AS avg_sev, MAX(log_http_status_code) AS max_status, MIN(time) AS min_time FROM otel_logs;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT service_name) AS services, COUNT(DISTINCT resource_host_name) AS hosts, COUNT(DISTINCT resource_k8s_pod_name) AS pods FROM otel_logs;
SELECT intDiv(time, 10000) * 10000 AS time_bucket, COUNT(*) AS c FROM otel_logs GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket ASC;
SELECT intDiv(time, 60000) * 60000 AS time_bucket, COUNT(*) AS c FROM otel_logs GROUP BY time_bucket;
SELECT service_name, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(severity_number) AS avg_sev, MAX(severity_number) AS max_sev, MIN(severity_number) AS min_sev FROM otel_logs GROUP BY service_name ORDER BY c DESC;
SELECT service_name, SUM(severity_number) AS sum_sev FROM otel_logs GROUP BY service_name ORDER BY sum_sev DESC;
SELECT resource_telemetry_sdk_language, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(severity_number) AS avg_sev FROM otel_logs GROUP BY resource_telemetry_sdk_language ORDER BY c DESC;
SELECT service_name, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT trace_id) AS unique_traces FROM otel_logs GROUP BY service_name ORDER BY c DESC;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT service_name) FROM otel_logs;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT severity_text) FROM otel_logs;
SELECT service_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM otel_logs GROUP BY service_name ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT service_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM otel_logs GROUP BY service_name ORDER BY cnt ASC LIMIT 3;
SELECT service_name, SUM(CASE WHEN severity_number >= 17 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors FROM otel_logs GROUP BY service_name ORDER BY errors DESC;
SELECT service_name, SUM(CASE WHEN log_http_status_code >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS server_errors FROM otel_logs GROUP BY service_name ORDER BY server_errors DESC;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN log_http_status_code >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN log_http_status_code >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS error_rate FROM otel_logs;
SELECT CASE WHEN severity_number <= 5 THEN 'low' WHEN severity_number <= 13 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'high' END AS sev_band, COUNT(*) AS c FROM otel_logs GROUP BY sev_band ORDER BY c DESC;
SELECT service_name, COUNT(*) AS c FROM otel_logs WHERE resource_k8s_namespace_name = 'prod' GROUP BY service_name ORDER BY c DESC;
SELECT service_name, COUNT(*) AS c FROM otel_logs WHERE severity_number >= 13 GROUP BY service_name ORDER BY c DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM otel_logs WHERE log_http_status_code >= 500 OR severity_number >= 17;
SELECT service_name, COUNT(*) AS c FROM otel_logs GROUP BY service_name ORDER BY service_name ASC LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c, service_name FROM otel_logs GROUP BY service_name, severity_text ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM otel_logs WHERE severity_text = 'ERROR';
SELECT service_name, COUNT(*) AS c FROM otel_logs GROUP BY service_name LIMIT 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM otel_logs WHERE severity_number >= 13 AND log_http_status_code >= 500;
SELECT time, service_name FROM otel_logs ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 5;
SELECT time, service_name, severity_text FROM otel_logs ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT service_name) AS services FROM otel_logs;
SELECT DISTINCT service_name FROM otel_logs WHERE service_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY service_name ASC;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT service_name, resource_cloud_region FROM otel_logs WHERE service_name IS NOT NULL AND resource_cloud_region IS NOT NULL) AS t;
